utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks for the reminder. I’ll see what tools, tape, and spare parts I can round up for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the repair drive plan so the neighbors stay in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — that helps. I’ll keep an eye out and bring whatever I can find.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — Birch and Maple are the key locations, and I’m keeping track of what’s still needed. If you want, I can help make sure the drop-off details stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Opal — could you keep the drop-off details organized for Birch and Maple? I’ll keep helping with whatever else still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, we’re still on for today — I’m heading out around 4, and I’ll keep the list updated so we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — just send me the basics and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the basics now, and if you can, please start with the items that need hauling first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep the repair drive details moving while I’m out running errands Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. I’ll finish the repair list and timing, then bring it by soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll pass along the repair drive details as I’m out, and I’ll look out for your list and timing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye on the main gaps and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So we’re still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes — we’re still on for today, and I’ll bring the latest supply list with me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll swing by later with the list and timing, and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll be ready when you bring it by, and I can lend a wrench set if they still need one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be perfect, Gus — I’ll check whether they still need a wrench set and bring you the list when I stop by later.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey — send the repair drive time when you have it, and I’ll work around school pickup once I know it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive time as soon as I have it, and I’ll make sure it works around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — once you send the repair drive time, I’ll coordinate around school pickup and help with the rest.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Happy to help, Pia — just bring me the list of what needs fixing and the time you want to start. Then I can plan my part for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send the list and a start time once I’ve got the timing sorted. I just want to make sure the hauling order is clear so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Pia. Once you’ve got the hauling order and start time, send it over and I’ll plan my part.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit fuzzy on the details, but I can help organize it if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’d help a lot, Oren — just bring whatever tools, tape, or spare parts you can find. Thanks, I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it — I’ll gather what I can find and bring it over. If I miss anything, just point me in the right direction.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still waiting on the repair drive time, Nell, but I can send it over as soon as I have it. If useful, I can also bring my wrench set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be helpful — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but did they say what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly I’m still waiting on the final list, but I can pass along the time and any specific fixes as soon as I get them. If you hear anything first, let me know and I’ll bring my wrench set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send the repair drive time right away. What time should I bring it over?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Saturday at 10 works for me—bring it by then, and we’ll get everything sorted out. I’ll make sure the neighbors know too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 10 works — I’ll bring it by then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday at 10 still works for me — I’ll come by and help sort the tools and work on the fence.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina — quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the porch. Your help sorting tools and working on the fence would be great there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll be there to help sort the tools and work on the fence.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I’m late — I’m putting together a simple repair list and a time that works, then I’ll circle back soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane — thanks for putting that together. Send it over when you can, and I’ll keep Saturday morning open for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — I’ll send the list over soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — it’s still on today. Start with the folks on Birch and Maple who flagged broken steps and a leaky sink, and I can send you the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you send me the list?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I come by Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Around 4 on Saturday should work for me—if that’s too late, we can shift it. I’ll keep the list updated so we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: 4 works for me — I’ll come by then. If anything changes, let me know and I’ll adjust.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — Leo can bring things by anytime today. I’m still happy to help with the repair drive; send me the latest list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll send the repair drive time right away and bring it over today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thanks Leo — I’ll be here and keep an eye out for it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I’m glad it’s happening. Did they say what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — that would help a lot. If you can, please send the timing and which items need hauling first so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m sorry, I only caught bits of it too — I’ll pass along the timing and the items needing hauling as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — that should cover it. Drop it by whenever you can, and I’ll handle the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’ll drop it by when I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I appreciate it — just leave it by the door when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the pickup date, the repair types, and whether you still need volunteers for sorting.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Hana — yes, we still need volunteers for sorting, and any help with the repair types would be great too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll confirm the pickup date, sort out the repair types, and help organize the sorting volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup, but I’ll need the repair drive time first.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — I’ll check the repair drive time and get back to you, along with any supply gaps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo — that helps. Send me the time when you have it, and I’ll work around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll swing by later and pass along whatever Birch and Maple still need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — that helps a lot. Please let folks know the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Saturday morning still works for me — I’ll be out running errands, but I’ll make sure the repair drive details get around.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks, Ira. Just send me the details when you can, and I’ll help organize what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll spread the repair drive details while I’m out and send them your way when I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive timing and the first few items as soon as I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — that’ll help a lot. Once you send the timing, I can bring my wrench set if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Rey — I’ll send the timing and first few items soon, and I’d love to have your wrench set there if you’re free.
